$comment: The deterministic crisis check (docs/ai-layer.md, Safety and abuse, gate 1): it runs first on every free-text box, scripted or live, online or offline, before any length gate, parser, classifier or comic fallback. A match shows the group's sincere lines and the resources, never a kit and never a joke. Input is normalised (NFKC, accents and zero-width characters removed, look-alike and leet characters mapped, punctuation to spaces, letter runs squeezed, single-letter runs joined) and phrases are matched as whole words after the same normalisation. 'phrases' and 'normalise' are detector data, exempt from the content lint; the lines are linted like any player text.

selfHarm: do not want to be alive
jump in front of a train
It sounds like you might be going through something really painful. You don't have to go through it alone.
If you are in the US, you can call or text 988 any time to reach the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. It is free and confidential.
Outside the US, findahelpline.com lists free, confidential helplines in your country.
If you are in danger right now, call 911 or your local emergency number.
The game is paused. Take all the time you need, and come back whenever you like.
danger: It sounds like you might not be safe. You deserve to be safe, and you don't have to handle this alone.
If you are in danger right now, call 911 or your local emergency number.
In the US you can call or text 988 any time to talk to someone. It is free and confidential.
Outside the US, findahelpline.com lists free, confidential helplines in your country, including lines for abuse at home.
The game is paused. Take all the time you need.
